name: Paid Gemini spend per day
description:
Shows: Estimated paid-key spend (USD, from token usage and billing.prices_usd_per_m) per UTC day, stacked by agent; the line is the daily paid cap. Runs on the free key cost nothing. Reads run.finished paid_cost_usd.
Why it matters: The direct money cost of the factory. Shows which agent spends it and whether we are near the cap, at which point work stops for the day.
